_doc: Meadow Pitch: the first arena on bought ground tiles (Szadi art's RPG Worlds Set 1) instead of a baked picture. Its floor is assets/arenas/meadow.tscn, built by tools/build_tiles.gd from the "tiles" block here (rects in 32 px tiles, 2 x 2 cells each) and the pieces below (cells); the breaking ground draws over it from the overlay tiles (assets/README.md). Rects are [col, row, width, height] in 8 px cells on the 84x36 grid. The deathmatch pads (the side walls' middle) stay clear.
name: Meadow Pitch

light._doc: an afternoon sun over open country: longer shadows, a little to the right

grade._doc: warm open air; a view-only tint and vignette (GradeView)

ambient._doc: pollen on the breeze, brush that sways, butterflies over the beds; see AmbientView

tiles._doc: set: the cut pack (assets/tiles/<set>_manifest.json); ground: its fill under everything; grass: rects of autotiled grass in tiles
